name: Limitless Nexus
description: Nexus build/test repository for Limitless providers. Proven providers remain isolated from active experiments. AnikotoTV now includes Android-safe base64url decoding for encrypted MegaPlay source payloads plus visible AES-CBC decrypt diagnostics; tokusatsu probing remains focused on KissKH Test and AsiaFlix Test.

scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus

scrapers.name: WCO
scrapers.description: WCO production provider with mirror coverage, strict title/episode ownership, anime identity support, specials handling, Power Rangers mapping, and clean quality/audio labels.

scrapers.name: AsiaFlix Test

scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based directly on verified-working Yuzono AsiaFlix v32

scrapers.name: Tubi

scrapers.name: Anikoto Diagnostic
